outputs.explanation: This is a photograph of dissected intestines, not a data plot showing averages, so individual data points are not applicable.
This is a set of histology micrographs (H&E staining), not a quantitative plot, so the check does not apply.

The box plot (total polyp number per mouse) shows only median/quartile/whisker summary statistics, and the accompanying 3D bar chart (polyp number by size category) shows only mean bar heights, both aggregated across n=8–18 mice per genotype. No individual mouse data points are overlaid on either plot.

This is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, which represents cumulative cohort survival over time rather than an averaged summary statistic; individual data point overlay is not a standard or meaningful requirement for this plot type.

The bar graph quantifying the relative amount of GTP-bound Rac1 and Cdc42 shows only mean values with error bars, without the individual replicate data points that were averaged to produce these means.
This panel consists of immunohistochemistry micrographs, not a quantitative plot, so the check does not apply.

The bar graph of relative expression (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) displays mean values with error bars and significance asterisks, but no individual data points from the underlying replicate measurements are shown.
